what: Photo cells flip a full turn (360°) in place over 0.8s at every 1.5s interval — a back curve that overshoots by 1.4 at the end and returns, alternating between the horizontal axis (rotateX) and the vertical axis (rotateY). Even-numbered cells turn one interval later so they stagger in pairs, and perspective is cell height × 3 (no smaller than width × 0.75). Pauses off-screen

options.axis: if only one of x·y is used, only that axis moves, default alternates
options.[data-fx-part=tile]: Cells to flip (children). If none, all direct children
options.fx:play: Starts over from the beginning when sent — when the scene changes and shows again

from.where: index.html hero diagonal·horizontal work strip (.mq__cell .wf-img — original scene 03 interval 1500ms)
